diagnostic_floor_sensitivity.note: 0.05/0.10/0.15/0.20 are sensitivity points only. No floor is recommended by this audit.

interpretation: The hard PM floor is a compression mechanism, not merely a safety bound: every candidate below its activation ratio is assigned the same raw PM and loses production ordering at that layer. Phase 6 quantifies the compression but does not select a replacement floor without out-of-sample 2026 evidence.
next_step: Do not choose a new affine floor from cross-sectional aesthetics. Carry the floor sensitivity candidates into the prospective 2026 outcome evaluator frozen in Phase 2A. Separately audit the 31 missing-candidate players because their fallback semantics are still undefined for V2.
